content:
Field
Description
DeviceTimeStamp
The time stamp the device action (e.g., connect or disconnect) occurred, not the time the corresponding sensor event was
generated.
DeviceUserAuthenticationId
DeviceUserSid
BluetoothDeviceType
The Bluetooth device type. There are two device types - Classic (BR/EDR) and Low Energy (LE). The value is gathered when the
device is discovered, paired, or connected.
Values:
BTH_BR_EDR (0x01)
BTH_LE (0x02)
NONE (0x00)
BluetoothDeviceAddress
Bluetooth MAC address, gathered when the device is discovered, paired, or connected.
BluetoothDeviceAddressType
Bluetooth MAC address type, gathered when the device is discovered, paired, or connected.
Values:
BTH_ADDR_PUBLIC (0x00)
BTH_ADDR_RANDOM (0x01)
BTH_ADDR_RANDOM_PRIVATE (0x02)
BTH_ADDR_RANDOM_STATIC (0x03)
